summary: The first mismatch is the #conduct window at step 1573: C appends an Achievements header and seven entries, but JavaScript ends after voluntary challenges because show_achievements is unported. Port the whole insight.c show_achievements function and its conduct/disclosure callers. A separate later stop at 1576 is mon.c minliquid_core stranded-eel behavior; its complete liquid-effects family is also missing. Liquid dependencies also require replacing existing split-call placeholders and correcting clone naming and copied fields. Preserve the independent stoning, passive, eating and polymorph cleanup coverage gaps.

source.branch: C insight.c show_achievements 2243–2402 returns for ordinary non-wizard play or an empty achievement list, otherwise appends to the active conduct window or creates a separate menu. It preserves recorded achievement order except ascension/Amulet reordering, formats possession-sensitive tense and gender-sensitive rank names, and displays/destroys only a separately created window. The wizard #conduct entry reaches the active-window path.
callers: C insight.c doconduct 2081–2085 calls show_conduct; show_conduct calls show_achievements before displaying the menu at 2230. js/cmd.js dispatches doconduct to js/insight.js show_conduct, whose achievement branch currently only records note_unported.
C end-of-game disclose/dump paths also use show_conduct; preserve final tense and active versus separately owned window behavior when wiring the whole function.
dependencies: Reuse insight.c count_achievements, remove_achievement and record_achievement, plus botl.c rank_of/rank_to_xlev and the existing enlightenment text helpers. Check their source definitions and current owners; ascension reordering changes the achievement list rather than merely sorting display text.

The later mon.c minliquid/minliquid_core 945–1122 scope includes gremlin splitting, iron-golem rust, lava/water death and recovery, steed/Plane-of-Water gates, and stranded-eel distress. Eel HP greater than one gates rn2(mhp) then rn2(8); monflee(mtmp,2,FALSE,FALSE) still runs when HP does not decrease.

Liquid dependencies include return-valued potion.c split_mon, mhitu.c cloneu and makemon.c clone_mon; preserve split current/max HP, RNG and planning output. Inventory chain calls whose discarded owners remain unported must stay named gaps.

Separate unresolved coverage: make_stoned/minstapetrify/do_stone_mon stoning gaps; unrecorded hero/monster stoning directions, corpse-weapon entry and attack-triggered stone-golem conversion; passive cold/fire/electricity/paralysis and lethal/recovery families; eating/non-food cleanup; skinback artifact-light radius and rare armor/Eyes-of-the-Overworld cleanup.

Existing implemented split_mon callers still have placeholders in mhitu.c passiveum and trap.c water effects (js/trap_effects.js). Replace them with the canonical potion.c owner when it lands, carrying the caller environment. The existing uhitm.c pudding split caller also needs the clone operation environment. Still-unported containing paths remain separate active gaps.

makemon.c clone_mon uses the return of shknam.c shkname when naming an unnamed shopkeeper clone. The canonical JavaScript shkname exists, but clone_mon retains a stale unported placeholder. Its C struct copy preserves mw, copies all EMIN fields including parentmid, and copies EDOG ogoal by value; current JavaScript clears mw, copies only two EMIN fields and shallow-copies the EDOG coordinate. Reconcile these source differences in the split dependency.
